name: Youth Advisory Committee (YAC), City of Menlo Park
org: City of Menlo Park, Library and Community Services Department
what_you_do: Teens advise the Parks and Recreation Commission and city staff on youth needs, activities and programs, and help plan youth services. Members serve a one-year term.
grades: Entering grades 9-12 for the upcoming academic year
who_can_apply: Must be a City of Menlo Park resident and be entering grades 9-12 for the upcoming academic year and committee term.
pay_detail: Not stated on the page. Treated as unpaid committee service; confirm with the city.
duration: One-year term, September through May. About 6 hours per month for meetings and events.
deadline_text: Closed for 2026-27. The 2026-27 window ran May through July 2026 (page lists a July 17, 2026 deadline). The next window is not announced.
how_to_apply: Submit the YAC application form and supplemental questionnaire to the Library and Community Services Department. Staff review applications, schedule interviews and make the final selection.
notes: Competitive, and closed now. Members must attend at least 75 percent of meetings. Contact Da'Shawn Williams, Recreation Coordinator, 650-330-2248. The page lists two email addresses (dlwilliams@menlopark.org and dlwilliams@menlopark.gov); confirm which is current. An older city notice said about 8 hours per month; the current page says about 6. The page does not mention pay, so paid_type is a judgment and should be confirmed.
